note: Google header chrome -- renders: Google apps and fixed product/navigation controls
Maps navigation controls -- renders: fixed map-navigation options such as Explore, Saved, Contribute, and Updates
Map toolbar -- renders: fixed map-view and navigation controls
Map control -- renders: one fixed operator-defined map control
Map utility control -- renders: fixed operator-defined utility actions
Sidebar toggle control -- renders: a fixed operator-defined panel toggle
Place-card action controls -- renders: fixed actions such as directions, save, nearby, send, and share
Map attribution controls -- renders: fixed operator-defined attribution, terms, privacy, and feedback actions
